push.title: L 2-5 vs YummyOrdaFC | You: 7.6
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.6 for a forward. A little under, a little lesson, a lot of upside.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at YummyOrdaFC's goal. You were hungry in front of goal, and I love a hungry striker.
+ Tackles attempted 6, up from your usual 2. Keep stacking those bricks.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. More of that, please and thank you.
+ Team-high 22 completed passes. That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.

THE BAD
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Here's a thought: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.
- 71% passing (22 of 31, down from your usual 80%). From the clipboard: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it. Believe.
- Red card. A little secret: No slide tackles from behind or as the last defender. A red card costs us the whole match.
- Their best forward posted 10.0 to your 7.6. Let's call that a lesson and not a trend.
- You and PhogsToffees both got caught on shot selection. Fix it together: cut it back to each other.

THE UGLY
! Red card: the team played a player down for the rest of it. I've watched it twice. It doesn't get better. Coach's secret: If you're beaten, sprint the recovery run goal-side instead of reaching in.

Practice pointer: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

Listen here, BellyTb1: Believe in yourself the way your dog believes in you.

The best is ahead of you. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 2-5 vs YummyOrdaFC | You: 7.3
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.3 against YummyOrdaFC. Not your day, partner, but days are short and seasons are long.

THE GOOD
+ 3 key passes. You were the playmaker, the matchmaker and the good-time maker.
+ BellyTb1 scored and you helped make it happen. Keep feeding those runs.
+ Tackles attempted 8, up from your usual 5. Keep that in your back pocket.
+ Team-high 33 passes attempted. I'd put that on a billboard if I could afford one.
+ Team-high 2 goal involvements. Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.

THE BAD
- 0 of 2 shots on target. Keep this in your pocket: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands. Rome, day by day.
- 64% passing (21 of 33, down from your usual 75%). Think about this: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back. Fix it and forget it.
- Won 2 of 8 tackles. Little homework: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away. Patience, partner.
- Their best forward posted 10.0 to your 7.3. That's a habit trying to sneak in. Don't let it.
- BellyTb1 struggled with shot selection too. Work on it as a pair: cut it back to each other.

Daily reps: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

PhogsToffees, take this with you: If it was easy, everybody'd be in Division 1.

Write one of these on your hand next match. I'm serious. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 2-5 vs YummyOrdaFC | You: 6.7 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Soup_Kitchen22, I've coached a lot of games, and a 6.7 like that one still gives me goosebumps.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against YummyOrdaFC, your first since Nov 3. You put it where Grandma keeps the good cookies: right on the top shelf.
+ Misplaced passes 1, down from your usual 5. Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.
+ 6.7: a career best over 8 games.
+ Fewest missed tackles on the team (3). That's the stuff I want framed.
+ 5 goals conceded: +0.2. Do that again.

THE BAD
- Passes attempted 5, down from your usual 13. Let's not make that a pattern.
- This result ended our promotion push in Division 3. That stings the whole locker room, and it should.
- 3rd straight match under 25% tackle success. Quick one: Get low and side-on. Square-on defenders get nutmegged.
- Lowest shots on the team: 1 (best was BellyTb1's 3). Start here: When you've got a clear look inside the box, pull the trigger. Hesitation lets defenders recover.

THE UGLY
! Their best forward posted 10.0 to your 6.7. We can't win with that. Simple as that.

Coach's drill: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.

Soup_Kitchen22, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: Don't count the days; make the days count. Then count the goals.

The team's lucky to have you. - Coach Lasso
